z.$description: Stacking order. A closed, ordered set — a new layer gets a name here rather than an inline z-index. The order is load-bearing at one point: a toast must never occlude an open dialog, and the undo toast must sit below it.

sticky.$description: Sticky section header inside a scroller.

toast.$description: Below the scrim on purpose: a toast must never occlude an open dialog, and the undo toast in particular must sit under one (SCRH-12). v1 ordered these the other way round and had to special-case the undo toast.

scrim.$description: Dialog scrim. Above the toast stack, so opening a dialog dims everything including any toast on screen.

dialog.$description: The dialog panel itself, above its own scrim.

popover.$description: Popovers and tooltips, which may be opened from inside a dialog.
